about: Fort Erie is a town in the Niagara Region, on the Niagara River and Lake Erie opposite Buffalo, New York. The Peace Bridge, Old Fort Erie, and the former amusement town of Crystal Beach sit along a long shoreline. It is a border municipality of several former villages rather than a single dense core. About 33,000 people live in Fort Erie.
seoSummary: Niagara border town opposite Buffalo, from the Peace Bridge and Old Fort Erie to Crystal Beach.
